journey.notes: Cinematic full-screen Bloomvale frame, readable copy, visible continuation, and automatic focus on the story action.
Objective and progress changed on each unique click.
Expanded five-district, meeting, activity, unlock, F-interact, M-map, H-manual, and gamepad truth fit at 1280 × 720 with no document scroll; Start held focus.
Briefing entered the authoritative explore phase; canvas held focus and the live compass pointed to Mayor Maribel at 320 paces.
Semantic travel reached Maribel; browser-native F changed prompt from Meet to Talk, people 0/5 to 1/5, unlocks 0/6 to 1/6, and MAP LOCKED to FIELD MAP.
CSP-safe SVG map rendered distributed world markers, one current route marker, and six upgrade cards with exact progress; close and Escape restored exploration and focus.
Server-authoritative movement traversed Heartlight Commons, Sunpetal Market, and Ripplewood; five wisps raised progress to 5/10 and Chroma Reserve raised Heartlight max from 360 to 400.
Browser-native F met Nori in Ripplewood, updated people to 2/5, and displayed authored dialogue in the event toast.
Six visible range blooms accepted semantic shots; progress completed, Prism Paint unlocked, and Lantern Fen settled with no overflow.
F at the physical Heartlight started wave one; clearing eight threats returned to EXPLORE with a visible Begin wave 2 prompt instead of auto-launching combat.
Expanded world remained full-bleed behind compact glass HUD, team health, abilities, named neighbors, enemies, projectiles, Heartburst ring, and toasts.
D input moved Pippa 161 world units; Space/click produced server-owned shots; Shift and E consumed active cooldowns.
M/M, H/H, H/Escape, and map/Escape opened one modal at a time, focused its close action, restored focus, and never resumed simulation behind an open panel.
Ready-state reload aligned to the server input sequence without replaying historical toasts; the first quick browser click was accepted authoritatively and raised shots from 0 to 1.
Unattended AI could not carry wave three; explicit defeat stats and restart appeared.
Restart returned to story one on desktop and compact layouts.
Meeting all five neighbors unlocked Heart Pocket; Pippa displayed 125/125 while the normalized health fill remained exactly 100% and exposed aria-valuenow/max 125/125.

Updated semantic controller crossed both explore breaks and completed all 37 threats in 29.992 s; Pippa 33 kills, Moxie 4, 114 human shots, 48% accuracy, Heartlight 360, final score 7390. Result kills, player-plus-ally kills, and all 37 wave slots reconcile exactly.

At 390 × 844 the document remained exact-size; the live wayfinder fit, the map used bounded vertical scroll with no horizontal overflow, six progress cards remained readable, and footer controls remained accessible.

A 768 × 720 tablet resize switched to the narrow HUD, kept route and progress readable, cleared Pippa from the previous left-panel overlap, fit the team rail into 57 px, and kept compact pause/resume unclipped. At 900 × 600 the top objective remained visible, the expedition panel compacted to 320 × 145, footer labels stayed on one line, and resize preserved the authoritative explore state.

A manual-tick isolated authority froze one real wave-one state with four surviving server-owned enemies. Desktop visibly marked the one threat obscured by the footer; 768 × 720 marked one southwest and one southeast group; 390 × 844 grouped all four as three southwest and one southeast. Rose edge arrows and count badges stayed clear of HUD/footer chrome, the polite live status exposed the same directions, wide view remained restrained, and the browser console stayed clean.

The 390 × 844 semantic snapshot initially read Scout PippaPIPPA because generated CSS content duplicated the real name. The compact card now fits the real Scout Pippa text directly and exposes it once.

A manual-tick isolated authority froze a real wave-three state at 142/360 Heartlight (39%), seven threats, and Pippa down. At 1280 × 720 and 768 × 720 the objective read Heartlight critical · 39% · 7 threats, the card retained a rose CRITICAL label and meter, the vignette carried persistent urgency, and the semantic tree exposed an exact Heartlight progressbar plus the polite message Heartlight critical at 39 percent. Both document and stage exactly matched their viewports.

A deterministic isolated authority froze a real wave-three state with Pippa at zero health, 4.2 seconds until return, 12 threats, and Heartlight 352. Desktop, 768 × 720, and 390 × 844 showed one persistent rose REBOOT 5s team-card state and a reboot-progress semantic instead of a misleading zero-health meter. After 2.2 seconds the rail measured 52.381%, the card and objective read two seconds remaining, and the progressbar exposed 2200 of 4200 ms. At authoritative return Pippa restored to 70/100, the card and health semantics normalized, the objective yielded to Heartlight critical state, and the assertive status read Scout Pippa is back in color. The portrait proof initially truncated the name beside the countdown; stacking the two labels closed that seam while keeping the card at 150.2 × 49 px.

The baseline downed frame simultaneously showed REBOOT 5s and green DASH READY/BURST READY. A direct pre-fix core replay proved the queued edges survived the outage and fired on return, moving Pippa from x=1080 to x=1228, healing 70 to 86, and consuming both cooldowns. On a freshly loaded corrected authority, sequence 1 carrying firing, Dash, and Heartburst was accepted but stored all three flags false; `/api/observe` reported down true, both readiness flags false, objective Wait for Scout Pippa to reboot, and only wait-for-reboot plus pause. The exact return stayed at x=1080, health 70, zero cooldowns, and no latent input. Browser frames at 1280 × 720, 768 × 720, and 390 × 844 showed a rose SCOUT KIT · REBOOTING card with complete offline labels; return restored complete ready labels. Tablet width increased to 240 px, and phone-width key glyphs hide so neither ready nor offline copy clips. The managed 8803 runtime was then restarted as PID 13776; live static inspection confirmed both the authority gate/scrub code and offline client, and the session was reset to story one.

A deterministic manual-tick authority froze a real nib contact at Pippa 92/100 with an 8-point source southeast. The baseline exposed only the changed health. The corrected frame paired a world target ring with a clamped southeast edge chevron and -8 amount, a rose player-card pulse, a bounded vignette, and `92 of 100, hit from southeast` semantics. The first center-anchored cue overlapped Heartlight and the first world amount clipped beneath the north HUD; both were moved to the safe edge before sealing. Desktop and portrait stayed exact-size; portrait passed both full and low motion. A separately frozen authoritative return event produced an ONLINE world ring, BACK ONLINE card state, and `70 of 100, back online` semantics at desktop and portrait sizes.

A one-millisecond baseline proved Nib contact damage was previously instantaneous. The corrected authority locks target and aim, publishes exact windup timing, and delays damage for distinct 250/360/520 ms Sprinter/Nib/Bruiser tells. Desktop and portrait midpoint frames kept Pippa at 100/100 with visible and semantic DODGE warning; an exact-time Dash moved her to x=920.5, consumed the attack as a server-owned miss, held health at 100, and displayed a target-bound DODGED confirmation. A separate desktop gallery showed all three family tells simultaneously, and a north-boundary frame preserved urgency through a safe-edge marker.

The pre-change replay ended a successful dodge with only a miss effect and an ordinary 24-damage next shot. The corrected authority awards 35 color, increments perfectDodges, arms one 2.4-second ×2 charge, exposes readyUntil/remainingMs/multiplier through observation, and clears it on fire, exact expiry, or defender-down. Controlled desktop and portrait frames showed the two-tone Pippa orbit, Scout Kit countdown and depletion strip, perfect-dodge and armed world labels, a visually distinct ×2 projectile, and a 48-damage impact. The initial impact was too faint and its toast could lose to enemy-popped; the final counter-hit event is ordered last, holds 1.8 seconds, renders a backed world badge, and mirrors `COUNTER HIT · 48` plus exact semantics in the Scout Kit when the target is offscreen or the wave clears.

Source audit found that pause stopped movement but continued advancing authority now, silently consuming windups, cooldowns, effects, reboot timers, and the new counter window behind a card that promised nothing advances. The corrected core maps external time around the pause interval, leaves state.now unchanged, rejects latent input while paused, and resumes with exactly one subsequent tick. Core and HTTP regressions freeze a live windup and counter/cooldown remainders across a 4-second external pause.

The first updated full victory cleared all 37 wave slots but reported only 36 kills because a lethal Heartburst removed one enemy without awardKill. Heartburst now awards every lethal pop before removal and publishes affected/popped counts. The rerun ended at 37 result kills, 33 Pippa plus 4 Moxie kills, score 7390, Heartlight 360, and a passing post-victory reconciliation assertion.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Ability presses on a result screen carried into the next round.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Transient input clears whenever combat is inactive, paused, or reset; browser regression showed both cooldowns ready at clean start.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Canvas intrinsic resizing expanded an indefinite compact grid row to about 1925 px.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: The shell and stage now have definite full-viewport sizing; compact document and stage both settled at 390 × 844.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Very quick click/Space taps could fall between 20 Hz samples.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Pointer and ability/fire keydown request an immediate semantic-input send while server fire/cooldown authority remains unchanged.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Large bordered header, four-card HUD, thick stage frame, blocky team rail, and faux-depth buttons visually dated the otherwise clean arena.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Rebuilt the shell as a full-bleed arena with compact luminous glass HUD, cleaner system typography, restrained controls, editorial overlays, and edge-anchored team status.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: The 16:9 fixed camera left large empty bands above and below the arena at portrait width.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Narrow viewports now use a bounded cover scale and player-following horizontal camera; compact combat fills 390 × 844 without overflow.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: The live-region announcer became visible after the legacy stylesheet was replaced.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Restored a standards-based visually-hidden utility and re-observed the fitted briefing at 1280 × 720.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Inline marker coordinates were blocked by the local CSP, collapsing all map markers into the upper-left corner.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Replaced inline CSS coordinates with CSP-safe SVG transform attributes; 22 markers were visibly distributed across the final map.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: After diagonal travel, a horizontal or vertical aim inherited the old zero-valued axis and drifted range shots.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Semantic input now replaces both aim components whenever either component is present; an explicit regression assertion and six live target hits pass.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Compact event toasts overlapped the bottom ability cluster.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Moved compact toasts above the ability/team stack and re-observed the 390 × 844 exploration layout.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: A reloaded client could begin again at sequence zero and have fresh intentions rejected as stale.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: The client now aligns its semantic sequence to the first authoritative packet and suppresses replay of old server events.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Repeated map/help toggles or Escape could resume simulation while an overlay remained visible.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Map, help, pause, and Escape now share explicit ownership, close semantics, focus restoration, and one authoritative pause lifecycle.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Heart Pocket could render Pippa's 125 health as a 125% wide bar.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Health fills now normalize current against maximum and update progressbar ARIA values.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: A click arriving while an input request was in flight could be cleared before the server accepted it.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Fire, dash, and pulse edges remain queued until an authoritative input response accepts them.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Held gamepad actions could repeat every animation frame and the Menu button was not sampled while paused.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Controller actions are edge-latched and the pause control is sampled during paused play so Menu can resume.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Cinematic surfaces did not consistently expose dialog roles or predictable keyboard focus.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Story, briefing, pause, map, help, and result are labeled modal dialogs with deterministic entry and return focus.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: The canvas motion toggle did not initialize from the operating-system reduced-motion preference.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: System preference now initializes motion and remains tracked until the player explicitly overrides it.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: The larger map supplied destinations but little moment-to-moment direction or exact unlock progress.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: A live directional wayfinder prioritizes the next useful route and the map shows one route marker plus exact progress for all six upgrades.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: At 768 × 720 the desktop HUD hid the live objective, placed the expedition panel over Pippa, and compressed footer labels into a dense wrapped block.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: The narrow play-first layout now covers devices through 820 px, while 821–1040 px keeps the objective visible, removes nonessential progress chrome, bounds the expedition panel, and preserves single-line footer controls.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Compact combat could report four threats while showing only three, with no direction toward the off-right enemy or the threat hidden beneath the footer.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: A camera-derived threat compass groups obscured enemies into bounded edge arrows with counts and publishes the same cardinal groups through a polite live status; server authority and enemy behavior remain unchanged.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: The portrait team card visually shortened Scout Pippa with generated CSS text, causing the semantic tree to read Scout PippaPIPPA.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: The compact card now fits the real Scout Pippa text at 10 px with no generated duplicate.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: A real wave-three run left Heartlight at 39% with seven threats, but after the short hit toast and camera shake the persistent objective, card, and green meter still looked neutral.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Authoritative percentage now drives stable, amber danger, and rose critical objective/card/vignette states, exact progressbar text, threshold announcements, and a reduced-motion-safe bounded hit flash.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Pippa could be authoritatively down for 4.2 seconds while her footer card exposed only 0; the recovery countdown existed only as world text beneath a live enemy crowd and the semantic tree still described zero health.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: The team card now switches to exact reboot countdown/progress semantics, the objective prioritizes defender outages, down/return events announce once, recovery restores health semantics, and the phone card stacks full name plus countdown without enlarging the footer.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: The Scout Kit advertised both abilities ready while Pippa was down, and ability edges submitted during the outage survived until return, causing an unrequested 148-unit dash, 16-point heal, Heartburst effect, and both cooldowns.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Authority intake gates firing and ability edges on live player control, the simulation scrubs pending edges throughout the outage and return tick, observation exposes only recovery actions, the client clears all queues while downed, and the responsive Scout Kit visibly switches between offline and truthful post-return readiness.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Pippa could lose health while the arena and HUD remained calm, with no authoritative source bearing; at the north camera boundary a world-only damage label could also hide beneath the header, and completed reboot control had no bounded visual hold.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Server damage emits target/source/kind/amount truth. A world ring, clamped safe-edge bearing and amount, health-card pulse, exact direction semantics, and reduced-motion-safe vignette expose the hit, while the authoritative return event holds ONLINE/BACK ONLINE world, card, and health semantics without relying on transient toast timing.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: An overlapping Nib could remove 8 health on the next authority millisecond with no pending attack state, visual tell, or semantic warning, leaving movement and Dash unable to anticipate the hit.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: All enemy families now begin server-owned, target-locked windups with mechanically distinct geometry and reduced-motion-safe warning. Resolve revalidates life, range, and invulnerability; moving or dashing clear consumes cooldown as an enemy-miss and produces target-bound DODGED feedback plus semantic confirmation.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: Reading a telegraph and escaping correctly produced no mechanical payoff beyond avoiding damage; the next shot remained an ordinary 24-damage projectile.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: A perfect dodge now awards 35 color and arms one 2.4-second Prism Counter. Authority, observation, Scout Kit countdown, Pippa orbit, distinct ×2 projectile, backed impact badge, offscreen-safe HUD hold, audio event, and accessible announcements carry the full ready-to-hit loop.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: The pause overlay claimed nothing advances, but state.now kept following wall time, so windups, cooldowns, effects, reboot timers, and temporary rewards could expire behind the modal.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Authority now stores a bounded external clock offset, freezes state.now while paused, rejects non-pause input, maps the resume timestamp back onto simulation time, and advances all timers by only the first real post-resume tick.

defects_found_and_closed.symptom: A full victory could clear 37 spawned threats while result.kills reported 36 because lethal Heartburst damage removed an enemy without the shared kill-award path.
defects_found_and_closed.fix: Heartburst now calls awardKill for every transition to zero health, attributes the pop to Pippa, preserves score/combo/effects, and reports affected plus popped counts; the full victory now reconciles 37 = 33 + 4.

rolling_buffer.reason: The selected in-app browser advertised viewport, visibility, and page-assets capabilities but no ephemeral rolling-buffer capability.
rolling_buffer.fallback_used: Repeated claim-driven screenshots plus DOM and authoritative-state observations at story/briefing focus, guided exploration, map progress, modal lifecycle, ready-state reload and quick-click acceptance, Heart Pocket health, compact exploration/map, frozen desktop/tablet/portrait combat, frozen desktop/tablet Heartlight-critical combat, controlled defender-down and Scout-Kit-offline start/return sequences, frozen authoritative hit-bearing and return states, controlled enemy-windup start/midpoint/resolve and miss states, three-family telegraph gallery, controlled Prism Counter armed/projectile/impact states at desktop and portrait widths, direct isolated input/observation packets, pause-clock transport proof, and final victory reconciliation. This samples key states but cannot rule out defects between frames.

console.scope: final 8803 story handoff and prior offscreen-combat pass; counter frames were not separately log-scoped

limitations: No physical gamepad was available; only the mapping and semantic lane were inspected.
No phone, LAN, or multi-device path exists by design.
Exploration and unlock progression resets with a new run; no profile persistence is claimed.
NPC dialogue is authored and activities are one-time per run, not procedural quest generation.
Repeated screenshots do not provide frame-by-frame rolling-buffer coverage between samples.
The 520 ms Heartlight impact flash is source and regression verified, but its exact live cadence is not claimed without rolling capture.
Defender reboot start, midpoint, and return states were observed under controlled authoritative time; the decorative pulse cadence between those samples is not claimed without rolling capture.
Defender hit and back-online states were observed at exact controlled authority timestamps; the 900/1400 ms between-frame fade cadence is not claimed without rolling capture.
Enemy windup start, midpoint, resolve, and miss were observed at controlled authority timestamps; exact 250/360/520 ms between-frame cadence is not claimed without rolling capture.

Prism Counter armed, projectile, and impact states were observed under controlled authority pause/resume windows; the exact 2.4-second orbit, projectile rotation, 850 ms world-impact fade, and 1.8-second HUD hold cadence are not claimed frame-by-frame without rolling capture.

Capability route is DEGRADED only for between-frame animation cadence: live browser screenshots, viewport control, DOM state, isolated authority packets, and deterministic tests were available, but visual.capture.ephemeral-rolling-buffer/v1 was not.

The live keyboard automation did not expose a trustworthy Space key-code path; firing was proven with an immediate browser click plus authoritative shot-count change, while Space remains covered by source and automated contract tests.
No long soak or broad hardware performance certification was run.
Visual taste, final balance, and release approval remain Mike's decision.
